capabilities: Rename pasted and drag-and-dropped attachments using template variables
Move attachments to other folders by editing the path in the rename dialog
Assign folder template values that feed the {custom} variable by note location
Batch rename all attachments in the active note via command or hotkey
Skip attachments matching regular-expression ignore patterns
extras: Not yet approved by Obsidian, so it must be installed manually from release files; install scripts are provided but minimally tested. Warns that enabling "Create missing directories" can create a mess of folders from path typos.
intentEvidence: originally a fork of reorx/obsidian-paste-image-rename, but has turned into a full rewrite from the ground up
motivation: The author wants to carry forward the core features of Paste image rename, whose development paused, while implementing missing features.
problem: Obsidian gives pasted and dropped attachments generic names like "Pasted image ..." and offers little control over how attachment names and folders are generated.

relations.evidence: originally a fork of reorx/obsidian-paste-image-rename, but has turned into a full rewrite
inspiration for many new features, such as better template syntax and preview in settings tab
copied their implementation for managing folder template values (right-click menu and settings UI)

summary: Attachment renaming plugin that renames pasted, dropped, and existing attachments using a template syntax with variables and folder-based values.
